fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB JE CBT I Revised Exam Date 2026 – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released Exam Date for the recruitment of Junior Engineer JE, CMA & DMS on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 4029 posts. Applications for the RRB Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 14 August 2026 to 13 September 2026. The CBT-I examination is going to conducted on 27, 28 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Railway RRB JE CBT I Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 14 August 2026
  • Last Date for Apply : 13 September 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 15 September 2026
  • Form Correction / Modified Date : 16-25 September 2026
  • Application Status : Notify Soon
  • Exam Date : 27, 28 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the exam date link.
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to submit the details by clicking on the Login button.

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
